book.inner_dimension.name: Journal of Inner Exploration
book.inner_dimension.subtitle: Unfinished Exploration Notes
book.inner_dimension.landing: I record my discoveries about the world within my body here. As I gain experience, the blank chapters will gradually fill in.
book.inner_dimension.category.first_step: My intuition tells me that my body may hold a hidden secret.
book.inner_dimension.01_signs.0: I once thought there was nothing new left to discover about my body. Then these remarkable sensory link dolls appeared, making me realize that my body might hold hidden secrets.$(br2)First, I want to craft a sensory link doll of my own and confirm that connection.
book.inner_dimension.doll_note: I need a sensory link doll carrying my own identity. Other people's dolls connect to their bodies.
book.inner_dimension.56_doll_use.0: I hold the doll in my offhand and right-click to use it and activate the connection. To place it down, I hold it in my main hand and right-click the ground.$(br2)Each animation requires the user to meet its gender requirements. The linked person is the person named on the doll.
book.inner_dimension.56_doll_use.0_part2: (The following features are available in newer versions of Non Player Plushie.) Right-clicking a placed doll with shears removes its clothes; using wool puts them back on.$(br2)Other creatures actively pick up dropped Sensory Link Dolls and may use them.
book.inner_dimension.56_doll_use.0_part3: While my own doll is being used, I can right-click with a compass to bind it to the current user. It keeps pointing to their location until a non-player target dies, or I remove the binding with a grindstone.
book.inner_dimension.category.entering.d: My intuition was right. There really is something hidden inside my body...
book.inner_dimension.02_threshold.0: With a sensory link doll ready, I began looking for ways to explore the world inside my body. Naturally, I started by poking all sorts of things into the hole beneath the doll...$(br2)All right, I think an ender pearl is bound to help with my exploration.
book.inner_dimension.02_threshold.0_part: But simply pushing one inside makes it shatter far too easily. Ouch... And that does not teleport me, either. I even began to wonder whether I was imagining the whole thing.$(br2)Eventually, though, I thought of a gentler approach.$(br2)I crafted an ender pearl and an iron ingot into a plug, then put it on.
book.inner_dimension.03_transformation.0: I slipped the Ender Pearl Plug in easily and waited for it to get used to my body.$(br2)It seems to need about a minute of uninterrupted wear. Taking it out means starting the warming over. I might as well keep it in while I do something else.$(br2)Sometimes I wonder why endermen can teleport. A pearl shatters on impact, so why doesn't attacking an enderman destroy its ability to teleport?
Where does it hide its pearl? As I pondered this, the pearl inside me began to change. I think I understand its secret now, but I still need a device to bring that power out.
book.inner_dimension.04_entry.0: Using the slimy plug, leather, and iron ingots, I made an ender pearl dildo. I can use it while holding it in my left hand. I also made a suction cup so it can stick to the floor. Hmm, this certainly isn't to shove it all the way in at once. It's only to study its properties more closely.$(br2)And don't ask why it has such an indecent shape. It was an accident.
book.inner_dimension.04_entry.0_part2: And do not ask why it has such an embarrassing shape. That was just an accident.$(br2)It is time. The size and length are rather excessive, but I am sacrificing myself for science, certainly not indulging my desires. Enough already. Just put it in.
book.inner_dimension.05_room.0: I really have entered my own inner dimension. Why have I become so small? Or has my body grown larger? So many new possibilities spring to mind.$(br2)This seems to be a space all my own. If I wanted, I could even open a department store in here. As for the customers...
book.inner_dimension.05_room.0_part2: The enormous pearl on the floor keeps reminding me that my body is filled with a dildo... No, what I mean is that sneak-right-clicking the pearl surface lets me pull it out.$(br2)It also seems that items and creatures landing on this pearl will leave with it.
book.inner_dimension.05_room.1: Since the Sensory Link Doll is connected to my body, how would it react to this dildo? I took out my own doll and used it on the dildo on the ground, placing the doll on top.$(br2)I felt a connection form. Using this dildo lets me strengthen that connection.$(br2)I think I understand now. A strongly bound doll becomes the exit for creatures and items inside my body. But why doesn't it affect me?
There seems to be much to learn about the connection between dolls and dildos.
book.inner_dimension.06_tether.0: I used a lead and a hopper to turn the ender pearl dildo into a tethered version. Really, I just wrapped a rope around it and stuffed a hopper inside; the rope connects the pearl to the hopper.$(br2)Now right-clicking the dildo opens the hopper inside it, and right-clicking while leading creatures ties them to the dildo.
book.inner_dimension.06_tether.0_part2: Of course, I can still use it normally before connecting a doll, and the knot makes it even more stimulating...$(br2)What I mean is that the creatures attached to the rope and the items in the hopper are also transported into my inner dimension. I have to admit, this is a rather novel way to play.
book.inner_dimension.06_tether.1: After placing the new dildo, I set my sensory link doll on it again to establish a connection. I began to sense just how useful this device could be.$(br2)Automation is essential.$(br2)So I tried using a sticky piston to push the dildo into the doll... Wow, are you saying I can now completely ruin myself just by repeatedly triggering the piston...
book.inner_dimension.06_tether.1_part2: No, what I mean is that I can actually use a piston to interact with my inner dimension. This is a revolutionary discovery.
book.inner_dimension.07_logistics.0: Then I discovered a few more things. If I hold a hopper and right-click the tethered dildo, I can place a hopper facing the device directly on the side nearest me. How convenient.$(br2)A hopper pointing at the dildo from the side transfers items into its storage.
book.inner_dimension.input_layout_note: I point the hopper outlet at the dildo and place the doll one block directly above it.
book.inner_dimension.07_logistics.1: By placing a hopper on the pearl surface, I successfully established an output route. The chest outside must be immediately beside the dildo to receive items, which makes sense.$(br2)If the chest is full or the connection is unavailable, the items stay in the hopper.
book.inner_dimension.output_layout_note: I place the hopper on the pearl surface and a receiving chest beside the main exit outside.

book.inner_dimension.60_void_fragments.1: I brought over a mental fragment and put both kinds together with a stick. Why a stick? book.inner_dimension.58_extractor.1: Void fragments really are mysterious. Beyond their powerful void energy, the fragments themselves come from a higher dimension. book.inner_dimension.58_extractor.1_part: I combined a void fragment and a mental fragment with glass and a few parts, and finally made a Semen Extractor. book.inner_dimension.58_extractor.2: The sample has a clear source, just what the core needs for its records. That saves me separating a mixture afterward. Looks like I finally have a proper sampling tool, even if it's only good for one use.
book.inner_dimension.36_abyss_ritual.0: I've returned to the very first question: what lies behind the abyss? The pearl that brought me here couldn't tell me. book.inner_dimension.36_abyss_ritual.0_p: This time I need to see it with my own eyes and contaminate it with my own hands, rather than let an eye of ender and an ender pearl stand in for my eyes and hands again. I have a feeling the answer is very close now.

book.inner_dimension.37_open_domain.2_pa: After coming this far, I thought I finally understood everything. But whenever I think that, something new awaits... Will it happen again?
book.inner_dimension.39_binding.0: Without a shell, I thought my domain would finally have no limits. Yet it still tires, and there are still places it cannot reach. book.inner_dimension.39_binding.1: Holding my own domain core, I held $(k:key.inner_dimension.toggle_open_projection) and tried scrolling the mouse wheel. book.inner_dimension.39_binding.1_part2: Without adjustments, its radius is twenty-four blocks and its maximum duration is one hundred twenty-eight seconds. Each step trades twelve seconds for four blocks of radius, or the reverse. I should decide how far and how long I need this time.

book.inner_dimension.40_open_contest.0: How does a domain without a shell contend with someone else's world? When two closed domains collide, their abilities neutralize each other. book.inner_dimension.40_open_contest.0_p: I must be careful. An open domain needn't wait for a shell to form; it begins spreading immediately. I probably won't have a second to counter it. Still, reacting before it reaches me shouldn't be too late.
book.inner_dimension.40_open_contest.ope: With the spare inspiration from just witnessing $(obf)UNKNOWN$(reset), I simulated different domain clashes in my mind.$(br2)When two open domains meet, both sides' engraved abilities remain active, but can only reach places their own domains actually cover.

A longer lifetime might let my domain survive after theirs shatters, though I think the best approach is to fight my opponent directly during the clash.
book.inner_dimension.40_open_contest.clo: If a closed domain surrounds me first, I can still strike back with an open domain. Expanding in time and spreading beyond the closed domain lets me contest it at normal strength. If I wait until the shell has fully formed, my domain cannot extend beyond it, costing me about three points of strength.
And without opposing shells, our abilities still won't neutralize each other. Strength decides which domain remains; if they're too close, both may still shatter.
book.inner_dimension.40_open_contest.ope: Conversely, if my open domain expands first and the opponent then expands a closed one, or if I expand from outside their shell, I gain an overwhelming advantage. My open domain's constant attacks against that fragile shell cost their domain about three points of strength, plus an extra three seconds of duration.

But once a closed domain begins expanding, it protects its owner from the opposing open domain's abilities outside. This clash comes down to who runs out first. Greater strength on both sides still means faster collapse: the closed domain loses some time according to both strengths, while the open domain's consumption multiplier increases. The first to falter loses.
Even with an open domain's overwhelming advantage, I must stay alert.
book.inner_dimension.40_open_contest.pre: Once an open domain reaches me, a short press of $(k:key.inner_dimension.toggle_projection) can still summon the Simple Domain I engraved beforehand. book.inner_dimension.40_open_contest.aft: Now I understand why bindings can be useful. A larger range may not help me win; more time might be what I need this once. book.inner_dimension.46_pierce.1_part2: Anyway, pieces of their wings, Phantom Membranes, should offer some insulation against the void's corrosion. I'll try making a protective sheath and fitting it over the Infector. That should let me place it normally.

book.inner_dimension.46_pierce.2_part2: Oh, and I must make sure the void is still contaminating my mental womb. As for what happens after the fall... I hope I can return to finish this entry.

book.inner_dimension.47_void_body.0_part: I'd thought I understood the void well enough. Engraving it on a crest and letting it actually enter my body are apparently very different things.
book.inner_dimension.47_void_body.1: I tried expanding my domain, but it wouldn't respond. I couldn't even summon the crest-selection wheel. Well, this time I've really broken myself...

book.inner_dimension.47_void_body.2_part: No, this is actually a good thing. I can feel the void filling every inch of skin and marrow. I've never been so close to Him.

book.inner_dimension.48_baptism.2_part2: When my sight cleared, I finally knew the baptism was complete. The strange condition had faded, and the pillar piercing my body was gone. I hadn't needed to expel the void after all. I needed to become able to withstand it.

book.inner_dimension.50_unlimited_void.4: Further observation showed that everyone withstands it differently. Greater capacity or higher desire provides stronger resistance to Unlimited Void. book.inner_dimension.54_boss_together.1_: Finally, with his strength, we outlasted the contest. The Throne shattered, and my domain, which had been close to giving way, stopped collapsing. I really owe him my life. I'll have to make it up to him properly later...
